title: Best Books/Courses/Channels to Leapfrog on AI/ML Material
summary: A user returning after a hiatus since 2018-19 asks for structured learning resources—books, MOOCs, and YouTube channels—to catch up on AI/ML progress, ideally akin to TeachYourselfCS. They also question whether understanding LLMs requires a different approach than pre-2022 ML models already in large-scale deployment.
